name: pulldown-cmark-rust
instr:
pulldown-cmark doesn't link bare web and email addresses like GitHub. Please add GitHub's extended autolinks to `/app`, off unless the new `Options::ENABLE_AUTOLINKS` flag or `--enable-autolinks` switch enables them. Don't add new crates. Each link emits `Start(Tag::Link { .. })` with empty title and id, one `Text` event holding the label, and `End(TagEnd::Link)`. Web links use new `LinkType::ExtendedAutolink`; emails use `LinkType::ExtendedEmail`. In `into_offset_iter`, all three events span exactly the matched source bytes. Like ``, email destinations are bare addresses; HTML adds `mailto:`. For example, `www.example.net a@b.com` renders as `

www.example.net a@b.com

`. Follow GitHub's rules, with these differences: - Only `http://`, `https://` and `www.` start web addresses, case-insensitively; labels and destinations keep source spelling. - Links start only at text start, after whitespace, `(`, `[` or `{`; web addresses may also follow `*`. - Web/email hosts need two or more dot-separated labels: nonempty ASCII letters, digits and hyphens, without leading/trailing hyphens. A host's following `:` requires a digits-only port. Bad hosts/ports mean no link, not shorter links. - Web addresses also stop at `<`, `>`, quotes, backticks, `[`, `]`, `{`, `}`, `\` and `*`. - Trim trailing `;` like other punctuation, and trailing `©` or `©` like `©`. Trim trailing `&name;` even for unknown
